categories.main_business_segments: Qi An Xin Technology Group primarily operates in the cybersecurity sector, offering enterprise-level network security products and services. Its main business segments include network security products (covering endpoint security, boundary security, cloud and big data security, and security operations), network security services (such as security consulting, operational security, emergency response, and training), and hardware and other related businesses supporting integrated cybersecurity solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies such as AI-driven security, data-driven security, and intrinsic security frameworks. It develops proprietary technologies including advanced endpoint detection and response, third-generation security engines, threat detection and response systems, vulnerability discovery, threat intelligence, zero-trust security, cloud security, application security, data security, and industrial control security. Production methods include software delivery, software embedded in hardware, and integrated security service delivery, with a strong focus on AI integration and platform-based product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qi An Xin serves government agencies, enterprises, and critical infrastructure sectors including finance, telecommunications, energy, public security, healthcare, and education. Its customer base is predominantly large-scale enterprises and government entities, with a focus on key industries such as financial services, telecommunications operators, energy, and specialized sectors. The company also targets emerging markets like intelligent connected vehicles and industrial internet security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant presence in major regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast China. It also has growing overseas operations, with subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Macau, Cayman Islands, and other international locations, aiming to expand its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qi An Xin operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the cybersecurity supply chain. It develops and produces proprietary cybersecurity products and provides integrated security services, including consulting, operational security, and emergency response. The company also engages in system integration projects, procuring third-party hardware to complement its solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven security innovation, focusing on AI integration across its product lines to enhance threat detection, security operations, and automated response capabilities. It invests heavily in R&D platforms and core technologies such as cloud security, endpoint security, zero-trust architectures, and industrial internet security. Strategic initiatives include expanding AI capabilities, platformization of products, service-oriented delivery, and international market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Qi An Xin generates revenue primarily through sales of cybersecurity products, subscription-based security services, consulting and operational security services, and hardware sales related to integrated security solutions. The company employs a combination of direct sales to large clients and channel sales through distributors and partners, with increasing emphasis on service subscriptions and AI-enabled offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qi An Xin is a leading player in the Chinese cybersecurity industry, consistently ranked first in multiple market segments such as endpoint security, security analytics, threat intelligence, and security consulting services by authoritative research firms like IDC and CCIA. It holds a dominant position in the domestic market with strong brand recognition and technological leadership, competing with other major domestic and international cybersecurity firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Qi An Xin reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.35 billion, representing a 32.49% decline year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.38 billion. The company has experienced significant financial challenges due to macroeconomic factors and industry budget constraints but maintains substantial R&D investment (over 32% of revenue). Despite short-term losses, it has improved operating cash flow and continues to invest in strategic growth areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qi An Xin differentiates itself through its comprehensive, AI-driven cybersecurity framework that integrates intrinsic security concepts and data-driven defense mechanisms. Its products emphasize real-time threat detection, advanced persistent threat (APT) defense, and seamless integration across endpoints, cloud, and network boundaries. The company offers a full lifecycle security service portfolio, including consulting, operational security, and emergency response, supported by strong R&D and a robust security intelligence ecosystem.
